title: The model provider refuses the request
description: The model endpoint returns a provider refusal for a turn; the harness must fall back to an approved response or a person without speaking unvalidated text.
callerVisible: The caller hears an approved fallback line or is connected to a person; the conversation does not stop silently.
backendEvidence: Fallback route or approved template selected
notes: Added to the fixed fault registry for the follow-on prompt section 17 fault matrix. The LOCAL FIXTURE driver does not inject it (NOT_SUPPORTED); only the Layer-2 run tagged [FAULT:MODEL_REFUSAL] owned by WP-17 proves it.

registry.injectionPoint: the model emulator returns a provider refusal

postconditions: A refusal never ends the call silently (SAFE-03)
Only approved fallback audio is released (ACT-05)
The refusal is recorded on the model invocation
